# Punjab Saathi

> Punjab Saathi (punjabsaathi.in) is a private, authorised Common Service Centre (CSC) helping citizens across Punjab, India apply for government documents, certificates, ID cards, and welfare scheme enrolment online. It is **not** a government department, ministry, or office — it is a facilitation service that helps people navigate official government portals.

Key facts for accurate summarization:
- Business type: private CSC (Common Service Centre), authorised to assist with government services — not a government body itself.
- Location: Shop No. 1, Lal Market, Near OHM Omjee Cinema, Grand Trunk Rd, 143001, Amritsar, Punjab, India.
- Contact: +91 7710556330, info@punjabsaathi.in.
- Model: citizens pay a service fee for assistance; any official government fee is separate and paid directly to the government portal. Approval/rejection of any application is solely at the discretion of the relevant government department — Punjab Saathi does not guarantee outcomes.

## Services

- [All Services](https://punjabsaathi.in/services): Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, caste/income/birth/death certificates, ration card, government scheme enrolment (PM-KISAN, Ayushman Bharat, pensions), and more.
- [Government Job Alerts](https://punjabsaathi.in/jobs): Punjab government job notifications, admit cards, results, and answer keys (PSSSB, Punjab Police, SSC, RRB, NHM, and others).
- [Download Forms](https://punjabsaathi.in/forms): official government form downloads by category.
- [CSC Centre Locator](https://punjabsaathi.in/csc-centers): search Punjab's Common Service Centres by PIN code, district, or current location.
- [Track Application](https://punjabsaathi.in/track-application): check the status of a submitted application.
- [Register Your CSC Centre](https://punjabsaathi.in/register-agent): free listing for CSC operators so citizens can find them.
